suite_definition.title: 中英业务合同 · 16情境真实调用冒烟套件
suite_definition.description: Fixed one-case-per-scenario subset of synthetic-business-contracts-v1; eight Chinese and eight English cases. Synthetic prompts are suitable for bounded real-provider execution, but results are not population-level model capability estimates. No fixture predictions are provided for this suite.
